title: Diagnostic 8-layer ZnS/ZnSe periodic stack with relaxed bounds
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count to 8 and relaxing thickness bounds will yield valid candidates if the previous failure was due to constraint tightness rather than missing material data.
design_principle: Quarter-wave dichroic stack principle adapted for LWIR pass/MWIR block, using ZnS (low index) and ZnSe (high index) on Ge substrate.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge (8 finite layers, 4 pairs)
manufacturing_considerations: Relaxed thickness bounds to aid convergence
expected_advantages: Relaxed bounds reduce risk of numerical rejection
known_risks: Material data may still be missing in registry
8 layers may not achieve sufficient spectral contrast
execution_request_english: Design an 8-layer periodic dielectric stack on a Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe (4 pairs). Optimize all 8 layer thicknesses for high transmittance in 8000-11000 nm and low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm. Use normal incidence (0 degrees). Initialize thickness search bounds at 50% wider than standard quarter-wave values (0.5x to 1.5x lambda/4n centered at 9500 nm). Enable constraint-validation logging to report specific rejection reasons for invalid candidates. Total layer count fixed at 8. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Prior route_03 failed with material_data; this route reduces layer count to 8 and relax thickness bounds per feedback to isolate constraint vs. data availability issues.
